name: AsteRISK Portal
description: A household inventory and kitchen management app for tracking groceries and medicines, reducing waste, and coordinating shopping with a household.
audience: Households managing shared kitchen inventory and medicine reminders.

publicRoutes.purpose: Product overview and sign-in entry point.
Sign in or create an account.

dataAndPrivacy: Household inventory and profile information is available only to authenticated members through the app. Agents should ask the user before taking any action that changes inventory, shopping lists, household membership, or medicine records.

agentIntegration.authentication: OAuth 2.1 using the user's AsteRISK account
agentIntegration.scope: Read-only app orientation and authenticated household context. Inventory database records are not exposed to agents by default.
